THE HTTP CONVERSATION INSIDE THE TUNNEL
TLS gives confidentiality, integrity and server identity. Certificates chain up to a root your device already trusts.
Methods: GET read · POST create · PUT replace · DELETE remove. Status class tells you who is at fault: 4xx you, 5xx server.
